doc_friction.issue: svg_lines(hline=0) silently drew no reference line because it tested `if hline`; at least three projects' figures pass hline=0 expecting a zero line. Fixed to `is not None` with a test.
orca.py needs numba for speed (about 50x); pyenv.py jupedsim numpy alone, as the 6d docstring suggests, would make ORCA milestones crawl. Asked for numba explicitly.

deviations.why: ORCA's crowd barely moves at half its fitted bias, so registered multipliers were chosen from a no-robot calibration on separate seeds before predictions were written, rather than reusing 6d's 0.25-0.75x grid.
deviations.did: Ran and disclosed a 7-point beta sweep (seeds 20319000-09) and set multipliers 0.02/0.05/0.1/1.0 from it.
deviations.result: Gave ORCA a street-like (0.72 own-right) cell that 6a could not reach; test seeds disjoint.

notes: 3,040 runs, ~12 min on 4 cores, /usr/bin/python3.13 with jupedsim+numba. Predictions U1-U8 committed (commit 1) before the full run; U1,U2 held, U3-U8 refuted. Checks: society-lanes tests 70 passed, _shared/test_linefig 12 passed, build.py ok, research_live_links ok, check_md_links ok, post front matter/links/similarity ok.
